# Sveltery Base

This is the documentation for the `@sveltery/base` package, a Svelte 5 port of Base UI.
It contains a collection of components and utilities for building user interfaces in Svelte.
The library is designed to be composable and styling agnostic.
The Tailwind CSS examples are written for Tailwind CSS v4. If `package.json` uses Tailwind CSS v3, automatically convert unsupported styles to v3-compatible equivalents.

## Overview

- [Quick start](https://base.sveltery.dev/overview/quick-start.md): A quick guide to getting started with Sveltery Base.
- [Accessibility](https://base.sveltery.dev/overview/accessibility.md): Learn how to make the most of Sveltery Base's accessibility features and guidelines.
- [Releases](https://base.sveltery.dev/overview/releases.md): Changelogs for each Sveltery Base release.
- [Community](https://base.sveltery.dev/overview/community.md): Learn how to use Sveltery Base with styles, where to get help, how to stay up to date, and how to contribute.
- [About Sveltery Base](https://base.sveltery.dev/overview/about.md): An overview of Sveltery Base, providing information on its origins, credits, and goals.

## Handbook

- [Styling](https://base.sveltery.dev/handbook/styling.md): A guide to styling Sveltery Base components with your preferred styling engine.
- [Animation](https://base.sveltery.dev/handbook/animation.md): A guide to animating Sveltery Base components.
- [Composition](https://base.sveltery.dev/handbook/composition.md): A guide to composing Sveltery Base components with your own Svelte components.
- [Customization](https://base.sveltery.dev/handbook/customization.md): A guide to customizing the behavior of Sveltery Base components.
- [Forms](https://base.sveltery.dev/handbook/forms.md): A guide to building forms with Sveltery Base components.
- [TypeScript](https://base.sveltery.dev/handbook/typescript.md): A guide to using TypeScript with Sveltery Base.
- [SvelteKit](https://base.sveltery.dev/handbook/sveltekit.md): Notes on server rendering, form actions, and remote form functions when you use Sveltery Base in a SvelteKit app.

## Components

- [Accordion](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/accordion.md): A set of collapsible panels with headings.
- [Alert Dialog](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/alert-dialog.md): A dialog that requires a user response to proceed.
- [Autocomplete](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/autocomplete.md): An input that suggests options as you type.
- [Avatar](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/avatar.md): An easily stylable avatar component.
- [Button](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/button.md): A button component that can be rendered as another tag or focusable when disabled.
- [Checkbox](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/checkbox.md): An easily stylable checkbox component.
- [Checkbox Group](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/checkbox-group.md): Provides shared state to a series of checkboxes.
- [Collapsible](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/collapsible.md): A collapsible panel controlled by a button.
- [Combobox](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/combobox.md): An input combined with a list of predefined items to select.
- [Context Menu](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/context-menu.md): A menu that appears at the pointer on right click or long press.
- [Dialog](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/dialog.md): A popup that opens on top of the entire page.
- [Drawer](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/drawer.md): A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.
- [Field](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/field.md): A component that provides labeling and validation for form controls.
- [Fieldset](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/fieldset.md): A native fieldset element with an easily stylable legend.
- [Form](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/form.md): A native form element with consolidated error handling.
- [Input](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/input.md): A native input element that automatically works with Field.
- [Menu](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/menu.md): A list of actions in a dropdown, enhanced with keyboard navigation.
- [Menubar](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/menubar.md): A menu bar providing commands and options for your application.
- [Meter](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/meter.md): A graphical display of a numeric value within a range.
- [Navigation Menu](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/navigation-menu.md): A collection of links and menus for website navigation.
- [Number Field](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/number-field.md): A numeric input element with increment and decrement buttons, and a scrub area.
- [OTP Field](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/otp-field.md): A one-time password input composed of individual character slots.
- [Popover](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/popover.md): An accessible popup anchored to a button.
- [Preview Card](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/preview-card.md): A link that shows a destination preview without interrupting keyboard or screen reader navigation.
- [Progress](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/progress.md): Displays the status of a task that takes a long time.
- [Radio Group](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/radio-group.md): Provides shared state to a series of radio buttons.
- [Scroll Area](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/scroll-area.md): A native scroll container with custom scrollbars.
- [Select](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/select.md): A common form component for choosing a predefined value in a dropdown menu.
- [Separator](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/separator.md): A separator element accessible to screen readers.
- [Slider](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/slider.md): An easily stylable range input.
- [Switch](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/switch.md): A control that indicates whether a setting is on or off.
- [Tabs](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/tabs.md): A component for toggling between related panels on the same page.
- [Toast](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/toast.md): Generates toast notifications.
- [Toggle](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/toggle.md): A two-state button that can be on or off.
- [Toggle Group](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/toggle-group.md): Provides a shared state to a series of toggle buttons.
- [Toolbar](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/toolbar.md): A container for grouping a set of buttons and controls.
- [Tooltip](https://base.sveltery.dev/components/tooltip.md): A popup that appears when an element is hovered or focused, showing a hint for sighted users.

## Utils

- [CSP Provider](https://base.sveltery.dev/utils/csp-provider.md): Configures CSP-related behavior for inline tags rendered by Sveltery Base components.
- [Direction Provider](https://base.sveltery.dev/utils/direction-provider.md): Enables RTL behavior for Sveltery Base components.
- [mergeProps](https://base.sveltery.dev/utils/merge-props.md): A utility to merge multiple sets of Svelte props.
